text.facebook: Insurance claims for anxiety and other behavioural problems in dogs nearly doubled in a year, and peak between September and November, says the Royal Kennel Club. Its tips for Bonfire Night on Thursday: feed your dog earlier in the afternoon, top up the water bowl, lock the dog flap and never take them to a display. My tip: walk early this week and be home before dusk. https://www.foresthounds.co.uk/blog/bonfire-night-anxious-dogs
